notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description, but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable; notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are detected, but users can create another copy and are not guided into editing the existing bookmark.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but use a generated letter rather than the page favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag fields are plain comma-separated inputs without autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-14: #tag query syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No filtered whole-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-22: Ordering is fixed newest-first; users cannot select a sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; reversible archive does not.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmark list exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
